notes: Official Soul Origin Product Nutritional Information & Allergens PDF, last updated 20/04/2026.
Calories are converted from official kJ per serve using 1 kcal = 4.184 kJ, rounded to one decimal.
Nutrition is for standard serving sizes and recipe specifications; Soul Origin says values may vary with custom orders or ingredient substitutions.
Vegetarian suitability is taken from the PDF allergen table where the Vegetarian column is marked present, cross-checked against live menu descriptions where available.
May-contain allergen flags and shared preparation areas are a trap for strict dietary requirements; Soul Origin says it cannot guarantee allergen-free products.
Dressings have official macro data, but they are omitted from add_ons because many are standard recipe components or low-protein condiments rather than useful vegetarian protein extras.
